title: Keep a named number
summary: Julia: Keep a named number. Start with 6 pencils.
introduction: A variable gives a name to a value. The plus sign adds numbers.
learningObjectives: Keep a named number with Julia

blocks.text: Install Julia. Save each example as lesson.jl and run julia lesson.jl, or paste it into the Julia REPL.
pencils holds 3. Adding 2 produces the separate result 5.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Quoted numbers are text, not values for ordinary arithmetic.
